event_summary: A comprehensive wedding plan covering auspicious ceremonies, venue management, multi-course catering, and candid photography tailored to your celebration.

budget_allocations.notes: Main hall rental, ceremony mandap, seating, and power backup.
Welcome drinks, traditional feast, live counters, and dessert station.
Candid photography, traditional video coverage, and highlight reel.
Fresh floral garlands, ritual essentials, officiating priest, and stage decor.
Nadaswaram/live ensemble, guest welcome kits, and contingency buffer.

tasks: Finalize ceremony dates, auspicious timings, and guest count.
Book the wedding venue and confirm hall accessibility.
Shortlist and book photography and videography teams.
Confirm catering menu and schedule a food tasting session.
Book ceremony officiant and list all ritual materials needed.
Finalize floral and stage decor mood boards aligned with your theme.
Send digital and printed invitations and open RSVP tracking.
Confirm acoustic or live music performers for ceremonies and reception.
Arrange guest accommodation and local transport shuttle.
Share final headcount and dietary restrictions with the caterer.
Conduct timeline walkthrough with venue manager and photographers.
Prepare ceremony ritual trays, garlands, and return gifts.
Reconfirm arrival times with all vendors and share contact sheet.
Prepare final vendor payment envelopes and digital transfer schedules.
Assign family coordinators for guest hospitality and stage flow.
Inspect venue decor setup, lighting, and sound checks.
Deliver ceremony items and welcome signage to the venue.
Brief wedding party on ceremony sequence and photo session slots.
Coordinate morning ceremony rituals and priest requirements.
Monitor catering service flow and guest seating comfort.
Complete family portrait sessions and settle final vendor sign-offs.

vendor_checklist.notes: Verify air conditioning, dressing rooms, parking, and generator backup.
Confirm per-plate pricing, banana leaf or buffet service, and staff ratio.
Include raw footage delivery, album prints, and drone permissions.
Include varmala garlands, stage backdrop, and entrance arch.
Coordinate volume levels during key vows and dining hours.

decor: Brass lamps with jasmine and marigold drapes framing the ceremony mandap.
Illustrated timeline welcome board sharing the couple's story at the entrance.
Warm amber uplighting with sustainable banana-stem and lotus centerpieces.
food: Filter coffee and infused rose-milk welcome bar on arrival.
Regional specialty feast featuring live artisan dosa and sweet counters.
Custom mithai boxes with cardamom and pistachio treats for guests.
entertainment: Classical instrumental fusion during the morning ceremony.
Curated acoustic medley during the couple's reception entry.
Interactive photo booth with themed cultural props and instant prints.
activities: Blessing tree where guests hang handwritten notes for the couple.
Guided trivia game about the couple during the reception.
Dedicated elders' lounge with comfortable seating and table service.
personalized_ideas.invitation_wording: With joyful hearts and the blessings of our families, we invite you to celebrate our wedding ceremonies and festive feast as we begin our new journey together.
